messages:
DeployBot: Heads-up: planned SDK v3.0 -> v3.1 rollout tomorrow 2025-05-20T02:00:00Z. This rollout will attempt to unpin runtime from v2.13 -> v2.15 where safe. Reply with 'hold' to block. :robot_face:
Priya: re-engaging eng-runtime + eng-sdk. SDK v3.1 adds a new streamed-kv handshake that requires runtime support for 'kv-session' feature-flag. some regions still on v2.13 and will fail if unpinned.
Dave: can we soft-unpin only for models that don't use kv-session? e.g., text-only models and embeddings. remember the last time we did a global unpin and it hit eu-west with a stale runtime causing model-bind failures.
Lin: yes. propose selective unpin routing: deploybot should route traffic by model-capabilities tag. plan: 1) mark SDK rollout as allowed_for: [no-kv, embeddings], 2) leave kv-enabled model groups pinned to runtime v2.13.
Maya: ops concern: how does deploybot detect capability? we have model metadata but it's not always synced. can we add a verification step?
OpsBot: Preflight check: checking model metadata sync status across regions... 14/120 models show stale metadata in eu-west. Recommend manual verification for those.
Priya: ok, let's exclude those 14 models from the automatic unpin. we'll add them to the pin_exceptions list.
Dave: rollback criteria suggestion: immediate pinback if any of these occur within 10m of ramp: - model-bind error rate >0.5% of requests OR - rpc timeouts >1% OR - surge of 503s for a model group >0.3% overall.
Lin: also add a safety net: if SDK telemetry shows handshake failures (kv-session handshake_fail_pct) >0.2% -> auto-pin. that's actionable and signals mismatch.
Maya: quality signal: if user-facing generation quality (MEASURE: rerank-based acceptance rate on eval-lite set) drops >2% -> engage ml + oncall for manual rollback decision. no auto-pin for that.
Priya: agree. auto-pin for infra/protocol errors, manual for quality regressions. set cooldown: no more than 1 auto-pin per region per hour.
Dave: runbook notes for pinback (short): 1) Run DeployBot command: `/deploybot pin runtime v2.13 --models <model-list>` 2) verify routing entries updated 3) scale up pinned pool if necessary 4) update ticket and notify customers. Keep 1-click rollback template ready.
Maya: ramp plan: start at 02:00Z with SDK rollout to 5% traffic for allowed models in us-west, after 15m increase to 25% if no signals, after 1h broaden to eu-west but only for models with synced metadata.
Priya: release-note snippet (for changelog): "SDK v3.1: introduces streamed KV handshake (kv-session). Requires runtime v2.15 for kv-enabled models. Rollout will selectively unpin runtime where safe; models with stale metadata remain pinned."
Lin: tagging eng-ml to validate eval-lite and confirm thresholds. Also posting list of excluded models to eng-releases channel once compiled.
OpsBot: Alerts configured: pages -> eng-sre on-call, sdk-owner, runtime-oncall. Metrics wired: model_bind_errors, rpc_timeout_pct, kv_handshake_fail_pct, p95_latency.
Priya: final decision: proceed with selective unpin tomorrow 02:00Z. auto-pinback enabled for protocol/infra failures. manual review required for quality regressions. excluded 14 models will remain pinned until metadata sync confirmed.
Dave: +1
Maya: +1 (i'll update the release ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3321)
Lin: I'll post the excluded-model list and the eval-lite results in eng-ml after my checks.
DeployBot: Acknowledged. Scheduling selective unpin event at 1751113200. Will report events in this thread and trigger pinback according to configured thresholds. :white_check_mark:
Priya: thanks all. if anyone wants a dry-run earlier, ping me and we'll run a simulated preflight in staging.
